question: How does consciousness relate to what it takes as its support, including the body?
premises: Consciousness first establishes something as its support.
It thereby makes that support operative.
Even when the body is such a support, it is comparable to any merely established object like a wall.
inference: The body has no privileged status apart from being an object established by consciousness as its support.
plain_english: Having first established it, consciousness makes it a support; therefore, even when the body is merely something established, it is no different in principle from a wall.
